items.description: Session panel sees both Claude config roots: in src/agents/adapters/claude.rs (ClaudeCodeAdapter::from_env, resolve_config_root ~L87-112, enrich ~L585) sessions are read only from $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects/<encoded>/... else ~/.claude/projects/..., so with claude-profile setups (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.local/share/claude-profiles/<name>, separate real projects/ dir) the other account's sessions are invisible. Make the adapter scan the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR root AND <home>/.claude when they differ (dedupe by canonical path; same path scans once). Keep every safety property (meta-only reads, symlink refusal, caps). Blank/relative CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR counts as unset (existing resolve_config_root semantics); reuse existing resolvers. Tests with tempdirs and injected env, no real-home reads, no process-env mutation.

Launcher honours CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and XDG dirs for host paths: replace hardcoded host ~/.claude in src/launcher/auth.rs (~L241,~L474 host token fallback / auth_status), src/launcher/run.rs (~L740 host_claude_dir, ~L1135 auth_relaunch, ~L1725 egress Host token refresh), src/launcher/home.rs (~L48-55 ro binds of .claude/agents|commands|skills|gsd-core|get-shit-done|hooks|scripts|.gsd-profile), src/launcher/sandbox.rs (~L255-256 .claude/.credentials.json and .claude.json masks; Claude Code keeps .claude.json inside $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when set), and check src/oneoff/launch.rs:261, src/oneoff/resolve.rs:916, src/launcher/config_dir.rs:446-449. XDG: src/launcher/sandbox.rs ~L238-265 credential masks (.config/gh, .config/gcloud, .config/glab-cli, .local/share/keyrings, .config/git/credentials, .config/gsd-meta-manager/driver-oauth-token) and src/launcher/home.rs ~L58,83,86,93-97 (.config/rtk, .cache, .local/share/rtk, skeleton dirs) must honour XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME/XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, falling back to defaults only when unset (blank or relative = unset, matching resolve_config_root / InstallRoots::config_home; reuse those resolvers). SECURITY: stored token path is dirs::config_dir()/gsd-meta-manager/... (auth.rs:39, XDG-aware) but the mask is $HOME/.config/gsd-meta-manager/driver-oauth-token, so with XDG_CONFIG_HOME set the token is not masked; derive the mask from the same resolver as token_path(). When a relocated path is outside $HOME decide and document how the sandbox treats it; keep both default and relocated locations masked if in doubt (deny-by-default). Leave /etc/claude-code, /dev/null, /bin/sh alone. Inject env in tests (no process-env mutation races).

Conformance oracle follows CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: tests/driver_router_conformance.rs Oracle::resolve / oracle_candidates (~L118-125) takes only HOME and CODEX_HOME while the TUI resolver (src/state_reader/queue_md.rs:116 via InstallRoots::from_env) also honours CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and the doc comment claims to mirror that order; align it (blank/relative = unset). scripts/install-conformance-oracle.sh:60 CLAUDE_DIR="$HOME/.claude" becomes ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude} (update comments at ~L27 and ~L299). Must not break the CI publish job or ./scripts/pre-tag-check.sh --container (no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR there; default behaviour unchanged).
